basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Fukuoka, Japan, majoring in International Relations. I'm quite new to the world of online gaming trading, especially in Rocket League, but I'm eager to learn. When I'm not trading, I enjoy historical costuming and researching cryptocurrency like DogeBONK as a hobby. My online hours are mostly in the evenings, as I juggle between part-time work and studies during the day. I'm currently single, and I enjoy connecting with people from different cultures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As someone new to the Reddit scene, most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and trial and error. My interest in cryptocurrencies and historical costuming is mostly self-taught through online resources and forums.
